name: JellyChat
overview: JellyChat drawer for Jellyfin SyncPlay sessions.
description: Adds a JellyChat drawer to Jellyfin web clients for SyncPlay sessions using a plugin-owned in-memory event stream. It does not use Jellyfin toast chat transport, an external WebSocket server, or additional network ports.

versions.changelog: ## Changes - Fix self-contained JellyChat asset and API URLs behind reverse-proxy subpaths. - Add Jellyfin Desktop safe playback layout: keep native video stable, inset controls/subtitles/header/emoji overlays around the drawer. - Add release/debug fields for asset base paths, runtime shell, Desktop safe mode, and overlay inset status. ## Validation - npm run build - dotnet publish Jellyfin.Plugin.JellyChat/Jellyfin.Plugin.JellyChat.csproj -c Release

## What's new - JellyChat no longer requires the Jellyfin File Transformation plugin. - Adds self-contained JellyChat Web injection. - Serves `jellychat.css` and `jellychat.js` through JellyChat plugin asset endpoints. - Uses versioned same-origin asset URLs instead of inline CSS/JS. - Keeps normal chat, playback action logs, floating emoji reactions, and drawer layout behavior unchanged. ## Upgrade notes - File Transformation is no longer required for JellyChat v0.5.0 and later. - Older JellyChat versions before v0.5.0 required File Transformation. - Restart Jellyfin after updating JellyChat. - If the JellyChat button does not appear, check: - `/JellyChat/Assets/jellychat.js` - `/JellyChat/Assets/jellychat.css` - the browser console for JellyChat injection or asset loading logs ## Validation - Browser Jellyfin Web tested without File Transformation. - iPad Jellyfin Web tested without File Transformation. - Normal chat tested. - Playback start/pause/resume/seek logs tested. - Floating emoji reactions tested. - Drawer left/right layout tested.

JellyChat v0.4.0 release. Highlights: - Adds Teleparty-style floating emoji reactions for active SyncPlay/JellyChat rooms. - Adds quick reaction bar, local emoji picker, favorites, recently used emoji, search, and quick reaction editing. - Keeps reactions ephemeral: no chat timeline rows and no reaction text in history. - Shows local reactions immediately, with constant-speed upward float, subtle size variation, and reduced-motion support. Validation: - npm run build - dotnet publish Jellyfin.Plugin.JellyChat/Jellyfin.Plugin.JellyChat.csproj -c Release - git diff --check

JellyChat v0.3.0 release. Highlights: - Adds timeline logging for playback actions so SyncPlay-related activity can appear alongside chat events. - Adds playback event parsing and grouping support in the React frontend runtime. - Preserves the existing JellyChat drawer and plugin-owned event stream release flow. Validation: - npm run build - dotnet publish Jellyfin.Plugin.JellyChat/Jellyfin.Plugin.JellyChat.csproj -c Release - git diff --check

JellyChat v0.2.1 release. Highlights: - Polishes the drawer layout and player/fullscreen docking behavior. - Improves injected frontend layout handling around Jellyfin web containers. - Updates README install guidance and project acknowledgements. Validation: - npm run build - dotnet publish Jellyfin.Plugin.JellyChat/Jellyfin.Plugin.JellyChat.csproj -c Release - GitHub Actions build workflow passed for the release-prep commit.

JellyChat v0.2.0 release. Highlights: - Replaces the injected drawer with the React-based JellyChat frontend. - Adds the plugin-owned event stream backend for SyncPlay chat messages and grouped recent history. - Improves video-player and fullscreen behavior, including docked drawer layout handling. - Cleans up repository metadata and editor-specific files. Validation: - npm run build - dotnet publish Jellyfin.Plugin.JellyChat/Jellyfin.Plugin.JellyChat.csproj -c Release - GitHub Actions build workflow passed for the release-prep commit.

JellyChat v0.1.0 MVP release. Adds a Jellyfin SyncPlay chat drawer backed by plugin-owned in-memory history. Does not use Jellyfin toast chat transport, an external WebSocket server, or new ports. Tested with Jellyfin 10.11.x. Built against Jellyfin.Controller / Jellyfin.Model 10.11.8. Target ABI: 10.11.0.0.
